skills.title: Find pages worth improving
skills.description: Prioritize existing pages with query and page evidence from Google Search Console.
skills.prompt: Which five existing pages should I improve next, and why?

sample.label: Synthetic example — not your site data
rows: Review the pagination section against the observed intent.
Check examples against the observed authentication queries.
sample.note: Two candidates in this synthetic sample; effort is medium. Content and internal links have not been inspected, so these are review hypotheses. No new URL or traffic uplift is established.
sample.coverage: America/Los_Angeles; unfiltered WEB; synthetic finalized fixture. Two candidate rows of a 50-row selection limit; query breakdown limit 20. Not complete site coverage.

skills.title: Find search snippet opportunities
skills.description: Find pages worth testing for better search clicks using comparable query evidence.
skills.prompt: Find pages that get impressions but may be underperforming on clicks.

sample.label: Synthetic example — not your site data
rows: Read the current title and page before designing a snippet experiment.
Compare similar non-brand queries before choosing a title test.
sample.note: CTR alone does not establish underperformance. These rows may have different intent or search result features. Current titles, device and market breakdowns are unavailable. No additional clicks are promised.
sample.coverage: America/Los_Angeles; unfiltered WEB; synthetic finalized fixture. Two candidate rows of a 50-row selection limit; query breakdown limit 20. Not complete site coverage.

skills.title: Weekly SEO review
skills.description: Compare completed weeks, investigate meaningful changes and choose the next actions.
skills.prompt: Review my latest complete week of Search Console data and give me three next actions.

sample.label: Synthetic example — not your site data
sample.note: Inspect the query mix behind the +40 clicks; compare device mix if available; investigate contributing pages before choosing a content experiment. These are three actions from a synthetic example, not a causal explanation or a scheduled report.
sample.coverage: America/Los_Angeles; unfiltered WEB; synthetic property totals. Page/query contributors and historical completeness are not established.

skills.title: Backlink gap
skills.description: Find referring domains observed for competitors but absent from a bounded target sample with HyperGSC when the user requests backlink opportunities or a backlink gap comparison.
skills.prompt: Compare referring-domain samples for my site and these competitors.

skills.title: Change evaluation
skills.description: Record an applied SEO change or compare its before and after Search Console observations using HyperGSC when the user asks whether a title, content, linking or technical change helped.
skills.prompt: Compare the observations before and after my recorded SEO change.

skills.title: Competitor research
skills.description: Research competing domains, their strongest pages and keyword opportunities with HyperGSC when the user asks for competitor SEO insights or a competitive content plan.
skills.prompt: Research this competitor in my requested market.

skills.title: Indexing check
skills.description: Check stored Google indexing and sitemap observations through HyperGSC when the user asks whether important pages are indexed or why pages are excluded.
skills.prompt: Check the stored indexing observations for these URLs.
